description: Frozen union closure. `boundaryCommits` are the ref tips that existed when the consolidation archive was extracted to its own repository. A blob is covered when it is reachable from main's own history (so it cannot be lost), or preserved byte-identical in the external archive (`blobs`), or listed in `exclusions`. The gate fails closed if a blob reachable from the frozen boundary, or from a live ref but not from main's history, is covered by none of those.
archiveLayout: <original-path> for archived source copies; historical-blobs/<sha1> for historical revisions
exclusionNote: The gate supports a documented exclusion list. It is intentionally empty: closure is total, so no reachable blob is left unaccounted for.
coverageRule: covered = reachable(main history) OR archived OR documented exclusion; required = reachable(frozen boundaryCommits) UNION (reachable(live refs) - reachable(main history))
